verdict.rationale: Metorial documents session-level tool filters that control which tools from a provider are available, with an explicit allowlist syntax (`"tool_filters": {"type": "allow", "keys": [...]}`). At the server/integration level, Workforce portals expose only admin-approved integrations and MCP access, backed by RBAC and access controls. Missing for 10: evidence that per-tool restrictions can be enforced as a central admin policy rather than per-session developer config, details on deny-lists or role-scoped tool rules, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
